title: Student App and Journey Integration
problemSolved: Students navigate a fragmented digital estate with no single useful place to start their day, and King’s does not yet have a coherent student-facing product and reusable app platform through which essential information, services and deeper digital journeys can be brought together.
whatChanges: King’s treats 2026/27 as a discovery-led mobilisation year for the Digital Student Experience Hub. King’s Edge provides the first substantive product domain and live delivery vehicle through which shared app foundations, student needs and operating assumptions are tested. From September 2027, a deliberately thin first live release gives students a common home with King’s Edge and light-touch access to timetabling, KEATS and Ask King’s. That live proof point then supplies evidence for where deeper integration is worth pursuing.
